core_categories: Home Medical Equipment; Clinical Rehabilitation Devices; Neurorehabilitation Technology; First-Aid Training Tools
specialty_focus: Shenzhen XFT Medical Limited is a manufacturer specializing in neurorehabilitation technology and first-aid training tools. It develops and produces home medical equipment and clinical rehabilitation devices, including foot drop systems, hand rehab systems, EMG biofeedback FES devices, pelvic muscle trainers, and AED trainers. The company distributes globally through authorized local medical device partners and OEM/ODM principals.
